property_summary: In the reference C, settle() clears the caller's guess slot, so after any settle() the caller can always lockInGuess a new hash (one-shot settlement frees the slot); the mutant never clears the slot, so lockInGuess afterwards reverts.
change_summary: Remove the statement resetting guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, so the guess remains locked and settle behavior differs on subsequent calls.
